templates.name: Mutual Non-Disclosure Agreement
templates.description: Common Paper standard Mutual Non-Disclosure Agreement (MNDA) standard terms, allowing each party to disclose and protect confidential information shared for a stated purpose.

templates.name: Mutual Non-Disclosure Agreement — Cover Page
templates.description: Fillable cover page for the Common Paper Mutual Non-Disclosure Agreement, where the parties record their details and incorporate the MNDA standard terms by reference.

templates.name: Cloud Service Agreement
templates.description: Common Paper standard Cloud Service Agreement (CSA) governing access to and use of a cloud service, support, user accounts, fees, and related terms.

templates.name: Design Partner Agreement
templates.description: Common Paper standard Design Partner Agreement for collaborating with an early customer to develop and refine a new product or feature.

templates.name: Service Level Agreement
templates.description: Common Paper standard Service Level Agreement (SLA) defining service availability commitments, measurement, and remedies such as service credits.

templates.name: Professional Services Agreement
templates.description: Common Paper standard Professional Services Agreement (PSA) covering the delivery of professional services, statements of work, and deliverables.

templates.name: Data Processing Agreement
templates.description: Common Paper standard Data Processing Agreement (DPA) addressing the processing of personal data and related data protection obligations between the parties.

templates.name: Software License Agreement
templates.description: Common Paper standard Software License Agreement governing the licensing, use, and distribution of software.

templates.name: Partnership Agreement
templates.description: Common Paper standard Partnership Agreement setting out the terms of a business partnership or channel/reseller relationship between the parties.

templates.name: Pilot Agreement
templates.description: Common Paper standard Pilot Agreement for running a time-limited evaluation or proof-of-concept of a product or service.

templates.name: Business Associate Agreement
templates.description: Common Paper standard Business Associate Agreement (BAA) addressing HIPAA obligations for the handling of protected health information between covered entities and business associates.

templates.name: AI Addendum
templates.description: Common Paper standard AI Addendum providing contractual terms specific to the use of artificial intelligence features within an existing agreement.
